images.alt: A side cutaway of one machine. A small sealed box sits at the centre, wrapped in a much larger assembly of pipes, filters, valves and a sorting tray. A belt feeds test cards in from the left, and a gauge at the right reads low.
images.prompt: A side cutaway of a single machine, centred in the frame with clear space above and below. At the centre sits a small sealed box with two ports, no bigger than a lunch tin. Wrapped around it and filling most of the width, a much larger assembly of pipes, filters, valves and a sorting tray feeds into the box and catches what comes back out. A short belt carries a line of small test cards into the assembly from the left. A tall gauge stands at the right of the assembly with its needle low on the dial.

images.alt: A side view of a pipeline. A patch enters at the left on a belt, passes a swing gate, a boxed test chamber with a round timer face, and a second swing gate before reaching a tray. Chutes under both gates drop into one bin. A large stopwatch hangs above.
images.prompt: A horizontal pipeline seen from the side, centred in the frame with wide margins at both ends. A single candidate patch enters from the left on a short belt, passes through a swing gate, then through a boxed test chamber with a round timer face on its front, then through a second swing gate before arriving in a small tray at the right. Below each gate a short chute drops into one shared bin resting on the floor. A large stopwatch hangs above the whole run, its hand near the top of the dial.
